CHANGELOG updated in PARENA: selfhost/emit.prn: emit-params now reads a param's own real declared C type instead of hard-coding Arena * for every param -- fixed a real, confirmed type-correctness bug (selfhost/lexer.prn's own new-lexer takes a String param, was being wrongly declared Arena *). New param-type-name/param-c-type helpers (String->char*, I32->int, else falls back to Arena*); only Arena-typed params still get added to the ArenaBinding scope. 7 new assertions (20 total for domain 4), CI green on all 4 jobs. Honest note: lexer.prn's own real self-compile error count is unchanged -- still dominated by unsupported non-alloc let-binding shapes, the next, larger step. PARENA commit 2e4bfc0, Apple #16379. session: sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)

⚓ ☃
